candidates.name: Connecticut Restroom Specialties, LLC (CRS)
candidates.review_source: BBB rating A+ (not accredited); no review count shown
candidates.partition_evidence: Own site lists toilet partitions among its products and says its installers are factory trained and ADA-aware. It covers restroom projects from layout to installation for offices, schools, restaurants, government buildings and stadiums.
red_flags: Distributor of Division 10 products, so a buy-around risk
Site lists two different fax numbers
candidates.reason: Danbury-based Division 10 distributor and installer serving the tri-state area, with commercial restroom installation stated on its own site. It sells partitions itself, so it competes on supply.

license.name: Construction Specialties Installations (CSI)
license.registry: Connecticut DCP eLicense lookup (Major Contractor / Home Improvement registration); City of Bridgeport building permits
license.license_type: none confirmed for commercial partition work
license.note: Checked 2026-11-20. Per research/state-licensing, CT has no state license for commercial partition installation: Major Contractor registration covers only large structural work, and HIC covers residential. Bridgeport's permit page asks permit applicants for a HIC, New Home or Major Contractor registration card, so the permit holder (usually the GC) may need one. The CT eLicense lookup is an ASP.NET postback form and wasn't queried. The company site lists Construction Specialties, Inc. (CSI), Ronkonkoma, NY, phone 866-746-8849, 'Serving New York, Connecticut, and Beyond', and no license numbers. The NYC DOB dataset has an EXPIRED GC record 603318 for 'CONSTRUCTION SPECIALTIES', but it isn't confirmed to be this company.
